%1 = run number, %2 = error message
Codeunit GSO IR Analysis Mgt - NamedType AnalysisFailedErr

trans-unit.source: No location or item matches the filters you set. Change the filters and run the analysis again.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Analysis Mgt - NamedType NothingMatchesErr

trans-unit.source: Quantity x Qty. per Unit of Measure (%1) does not equal Qty. (Base) (%2) in the warehouse entries.
trans-unit.note: %1 = calculated base quantity, %2 = base quantity
Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType BaseQtyMismatchCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The bin holds quantity but is blocked for %1 movement.
trans-unit.note: %1 = inbound, outbound or all
Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType BlockedBinCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The warehouse entries use %1 base units per unit, but the item unit of measure now has %2. Calculate Warehouse Adjustment can fail or post wrong quantities.
trans-unit.note: %1 = old quantity per unit, %2 = current quantity per unit
Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType ChangedQtyPerUoMCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The bin does not exist at this location. It was deleted or renamed while it held quantity.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType MissingBinCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The warehouse entries hold quantity in this bin, but the bin content line for the item, variant and unit of measure is missing. The quantity is not shown in Bin Contents and is not offered for picks.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType MissingBinContentCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The warehouse entries use a unit of measure that the item no longer has.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType MissingUnitOfMeasureCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The bin content is negative. Quantity was taken from the bin that the warehouse entries never put into it.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType NegativeBinContentCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The location uses directed put-away and pick but has no adjustment bin, so warehouse adjustments cannot be posted to the item ledger.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType NoAdjustmentBinCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: Warehouse entries without a bin code hold quantity at a location where bins are mandatory.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType NoBinCodeCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: Warehouse physical inventory journal %1 has lines for this location while the adjustment bin still holds pending adjustments.
trans-unit.note: %1 = journal template name
Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType OpenPhysInventoryCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: A warehouse adjustment of %1 is registered in the adjustment bin but not yet posted to the item ledger.
trans-unit.note: %1 = quantity
Codeunit GSO IR Bin Rules - NamedType PendingAdjustmentCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: Export the evidence and ask your partner. No standard posting changes only one side, so do not try to fix this with an item or warehouse journal.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R1AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Check the item tracking lines of the documents posted on the first date. No standard posting changes only one side, so ask your partner.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R2AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Run Calculate Warehouse Adjustment in the item journal and post it. Use Preview Posting first. Microsoft recommends posting warehouse adjustments regularly.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R3AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Check the warehouse entries of the bin, then move or reclassify quantity into the bin with a movement or a warehouse reclassification journal.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R4AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Correct the unit of measure before you run Calculate Warehouse Adjustment. Do not change Qty. per Unit of Measure while the unit is used in bins.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R5AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Move the quantity to a valid bin with a movement or a warehouse reclassification journal before you block or delete the bin.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R6AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Known issue: post a positive adjustment with Applies-from Entry and a negative adjustment of the same quantity with Applies-to Entry (Microsoft workaround). Otherwise ask your partner.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R7AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Run Calculate Warehouse Adjustment and post it before you count. Microsoft: synchronize item ledger and warehouse data before you count physical inventory.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R8AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Create the bin content line for this bin, item, variant and unit of measure on the Bin Contents page. Its quantity is calculated from the warehouse entries, so no posting is needed.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Finding Mgt - NamedType R9AdviceTxt

trans-unit.source: Inventory is zero, but open inbound and outbound entries remain. This is the Microsoft known item application issue, often after posting without stock and then a credit memo or undo shipment.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType KnownApplicationIssueCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: Bins hold quantity that the item ledger does not have. Warehouse entries were probably registered without the matching item posting.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType NoItemLedgerQtyCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: Inventory exists in the item ledger but not in any bin. The location may have been switched to Bin Mandatory while it held stock, or entries were posted without a bin.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType NoWarehouseQtyCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The remaining quantity of the open item ledger entries (%1) does not match the inventory (%2). The item application is damaged.
trans-unit.note: %1 = remaining quantity, %2 = inventory
Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType RemainingDiffersCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The item ledger and the warehouse totals (all bins, including the adjustment bin) differ. No standard posting changes only one side.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType TotalsDifferCauseTxt

trans-unit.source: The item total agrees, but the quantity per lot, serial or package number differs between the item ledger and the warehouse entries.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit GSO IR Ledger Rules - NamedType TrackingDiffersCauseTxt
